answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every new identity to post a refundable stake of 50 credits that is slashed on proven spam, while reputation flows like a vine along a trust graph: each verified agent vouches for at most 3 newcomers, and a vertex with too many fake edges loses its stake. A gale of 10,000 fake accounts would then cost 500,000 credits up front, far more than the rewards a single epoch pays, so mass fakery stops paying for itself.
